description: List the audit log (GET /v1/audit-log). Scoped to your account; admin role only (viewer/member get 403). Lets an AI agent autonomously review recent operation history such as invitations / API key revocations / project changes. Filters = eventType ('invitation.created' / 'api_key.revoked' etc.) / targetKind / actorUserId / from / to. Supports cursor pagination (nextCursor format = 'created_at|id'), max limit 200.

actorUserId.description: actor_user_id filter (only a specific user's operations)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (pass the previous response's nextCursor as-is, 'created_at|id' format)

name: list_audit_log
